shots.name: keyart
shots.prompt:
An editorial product photograph. One open laptop sits on a slab of dark perforated metal, photographed from slightly above and a little to the left, the screen tilted back and filling the middle of the frame.

On the screen, reproduce the supplied interface exactly as supplied: same layout, same text, same spacing, same colours, same red dotted sphere. Do not redraw, restyle or invent any interface element. Keep the text crisp and legible.

Set: the perforated metal runs edge to edge across the lower two thirds, its holes catching small pools of shadow. Behind it, a flat charcoal wall in soft shade. Nothing else is on the surface. No cables, no mug, no notebook, no props of any kind.

Light: one hard directional light from the upper left, as if late sun through a window. It throws a single crisp diagonal shadow of the laptop across the metal and a clean shadow edge on the wall behind. The rest of the scene falls into calm even shade.

Strictly avoid: glow, bloom, haze, fog, volumetric light, lens flare, neon rim lighting, floating or hovering elements, multiple screens, glass panes, particles, reflections or glare across the screen face, dark voids, sci-fi styling.

Finish: real photography on a 50mm lens at f5.6, deep enough focus that the metal texture reads. Matter of fact, calm, expensive. Generous empty space above the laptop, subject weighted to the centre. No text anywhere outside the screen, no logos, no people, no hands.

shots.prompt:

Propped on the ledge beside the headset, angled toward the camera, is a flat matte display panel showing the supplied interface. Reproduce that interface exactly as supplied: same layout, same text, same buttons, same cyan and blue colours. Do not redraw, restyle or invent any interface element. Keep the text crisp and legible.

Set: a plain pale concrete wall behind, a concrete ledge running across the lower third. Nothing else in frame. No cables, no amplifier, no music stand, no plectrums, no props of any kind.

Light: one hard directional light from the upper left, throwing a single crisp shadow of the headset and the guitar neck across the concrete.

Strictly avoid: glow, bloom, haze, volumetric light, lens flare, neon rim lighting, holograms, floating or hovering elements, light beams or ribbons, particles, reflections or glare across the panel face, dark voids, sci-fi styling.

Finish: real photography on a 50mm lens at f5.6, deep enough focus that the concrete texture reads. Restrained, physical, calm. Generous empty space above, subject weighted to the centre. No text anywhere outside the panel, no logos, no people, no hands.

shots.name: keyart
shots.prompt:
An editorial product photograph of a powered wheelchair, lit like a press shot for a piece of hardware. The chair stands at the centre of the frame on a smooth pale floor, turned at a three quarter angle so both the seat and the small tablet mounted at its left armrest face the camera. Nobody is in the chair and no people are in the frame.

On the mounted screen, reproduce the supplied navigation interface exactly as supplied: same layout, same labels, same red button, same colours. Do not redraw, restyle or invent any interface element. Keep the text crisp and legible.

Set: a seamless mid grey backdrop curving into the floor with no visible horizon line. Nothing else in frame. No ramps, no doorways, no plants, no props of any kind.

Materials: the chair reads as a real manufactured object, with distinct surfaces for the moulded shell, the fabric seat, the black rubber tyres and the metal frame.

Light: one hard directional light from the upper left, throwing a single clean shadow of the chair across the floor, plus soft fill so the dark tyres still hold detail.

Strictly avoid: glow, bloom, haze, volumetric light, lens flare, floating or hovering elements, extra screens, glass panes, particles, reflections or glare across the screen face, dark voids, sci-fi styling.

Finish: real studio photography on a 50mm lens at f8, deep focus. Serious, clean, matter of fact. Generous empty space above the chair, subject weighted to the centre. No text anywhere outside the screen, no logos.
